Title: [P0][prompts][backend+frontend] Fix LLM advanced params persistence and raise defaults

Title: [P0][outline][backend] Harden chapter coverage when weak models under-generate
Description: Harden outline generation for long-form targets by enforcing target chapter coverage in server post-parse step: if parsed chapters are fewer than target and parse succeeded, auto-fill missing chapter numbers with explicit fail-soft beats and warnings, keeping API compatibility.
Acceptance: When `requirements.chapter_count` is provided and model returns partial chapters, response `chapters` covers full range `1..chapter_count` with warning markers; existing parse-error path remains compatible.
